scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Brasilis^000000, a country as passionate as the sun.
If you have any questions, please ask me.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
歡迎來到^8B4513巴西^000000，這個如太陽般熱情的國度。
有什麼問題，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Where can I guide you?

[Brasilis Guide]
The {0} is located just above, ^FF3355+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
{0}就在上方的^FF3355+^000000處。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Do you want to go through the rough jungle? You can take a 
{0} here ^CE6300+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
想穿越險峻的叢林嗎？
可以在^CE6300+^000000處乘坐{0}。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The pride of Brasilis, the world scale {0} is at ^A5BAAD+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
巴西的驕傲——世界級的{0}就在^A5BAAD+^000000處。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
You can buy items for hunting at the {0} here ^55FF33+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
您可以在^55FF33+^000000處的{0}購買狩獵用品。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The iconic monument of Brasilis, the {0} stands at ^3355FF+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
巴西的標誌性紀念碑{0}矗立在^3355FF+^000000處。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
我會清除您小地圖上的所有標記。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Wandering on your own is always the best way to explore. Anyway, take care.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
想探索一番，最好還是自己四處走走。
總之，請多保重。
